mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it signals a recovery in the labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS increases, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with an increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates a shift in demand from residential investment to other sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases and GDPC1 increases, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of supply-side constraints, an increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market and increased productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
